comment: WP38: the bitstream set of mnrun.py (mncore/fpga/multi/README.md). Each member is mn_top_multi with these parameters (build.py --member <name>; the bitstream is build/<name>/top_multi.fs). UNITS 2: L1BM + L2BM + MV, 1: L1BM only (files_l1.txt), 0: none. SDRAM 0: no SDRAM controller (the SDRAM in self refresh, no PDM / DRAM spaces). When several members can run a segment, the first in this order is taken (unless one of them is loaded already).

members.name: M2a
members.desc: integer ALU, L1BM, L2BM, MV (the M2a of WP37), zero rule

members.name: M2aR
members.desc: M2a with the replica rule (WP37 M2a-R)

members.name: MAU
members.desc: one MAB: integer ALU and the vector MAU, with the SDRAM (PDM / DRAM)

members.name: MAUF3
members.desc: one MAB: integer ALU, MAU, FP ALU without floor / ftoi / fmax / fmin (FPALU 3); no SDRAM controller

members.name: L1MAU
members.desc: L1BM (no reductions) and the MAU in one bitstream, zero rule; no L2BM / MV / SDRAM controller
